# Reusable Prompts — samplekata

> A small library of prompts that have worked well for this project.
> Each entry should be specific enough that pasting it into a fresh
> agent session produces useful output without further context.

---

## Format

Each entry uses the following structure:

### _Short prompt title_

**Goal**

> One sentence on what this prompt is supposed to accomplish.

**Prompt**

```text
…the actual prompt text…
```

**Notes**

> Caveats, when to use, expected output shape, and any required pre-reads
> (e.g. "read SPEC.md §3 first").

---

## Entries

_No prompts yet. Add one once you have a workflow that's been validated
on this project._
